messages.subject: Re: Company info
messages.text:
Hi Erika,
 

 Thank you so much for your interest in our company and for your kind words about our environmental focus — we truly appreciate it 💛
 

 Our company is located in Quebec City, Canada . We operate from our boutique and workshop:
 

 Lasclay – Boutique & Atelier 
Products available: Full collection + exclusives + prototypes
254 Bd des Capucins
Quebec City, QC G1J 3R4

 

 If you have any other questions about our products or our mission, we’d be happy to help!
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Laurence 
 

 Lasclay
